metadata.name: kent

releases.body:
- Several improvements to the BLAT results page based on user feedback, including alignment mouseovers in hgTracks that show the query range and aligned bases
- Mismatch and insertion marks on alignment tracks are brighter and now have mouseovers that explain what they are
- Fixed bugs in the "Hide all other tracks" right-click option: hiding a track from the image now also updates its menu in the track list, and more buttons have icons
- New "My Data > Recent Browser Views" page that lists recently viewed browser states, behind an hg.conf setting that is off by default, and not yet on the RR
- Removed the broken Login link from the header of background status pages of hgSession and hgTables, such as the custom track backup page
- Faceted composite metadata with an apostrophe inside a word, as in "Peyer's patch", is no longer read as the start of a quoted field
- gff3ToGenePred now joins a multi-exon CDS that is a direct child of a gene, as in NCBI GFF files of EMBL-submitted assemblies
- BLAT result details pages once again show the alignment that was clicked, at the top of the list of the query's alignments
- When using the new BLAT page, pressing return to search again from the results page no longer loses the query sequence
- With quickLiftMultiChain off, a quickLifted item without blocks that two chains each partly covered was dropped as "Duplicated in new" (hg19 MRC1 lifted to hg38 vanished); such items now lift through the chain with the most aligned bases, for plain beds, ENCODE peaks, and GTEx genes, and on their details pages
- hgTrackUi prints filter labels and their tooltips more cleanly
- RepeatMasker Viz. in full mode at window sizes above 30 kb never drew an aligned block that started at the item's own start, so some repeats were missing entirely; these blocks are now drawn
- quickLift can now lift RepeatMasker tracks (rmsk, RepeatMasker Viz., and bigRmsk) in hgTracks and hgc, behind the browser.quickLiftRmsk setting, which is off by default and can be overridden by a cart variable
- Code review fixes for lifted RepeatMasker tracks: a lifted RepeatMasker Viz. track and the native one shared a layout, so one of them drew nothing, and the details page of a lifted rmsk item on a '-' chain showed the wrong Begin and Left in repeat; both now behave correctly
- hgc crashed when an rmskJoined track name was not in trackDb, and the bigRmsk details page did not check the bigBed column counts; hgc now handles both, skips missing .out and .align sections, and hgTracks builds the bigRmsk class table before tracks load in parallel
- quickLift kept lifted beds and peaks that landed outside the window, which produced the "map items spill over track bounds" warning; now only items that overlap the window are kept
- Reading many chains from a bigChain was quadratic (5,000 overlapping regions took 12 seconds per call); links are now grouped by chain id in one pass, which speeds up quickLift, bigChain tracks, hgc, and hgGene
- The list of vetted quickLift tracks was rebuilt on every call, and a composite view with no subtracks could crash quickLift; the list is now built once and an empty view is handled
- The hgc page for a lifted bed track showed the first item in the window, not the item that was clicked; it now shows the clicked item
- hgConvert stopped on a missing table when a composite's first view had no subtracks; each child of a composite is now checked on its own and empty views are skipped
- The faster bigChain link lookup now starts with a smaller hash, which removes a fixed cost on each call
- Final review fixes to lifted RepeatMasker details pages: duplicate rows, an error on a missing repeat, and a lifted bigRmsk item on the wrong chrom; each page now shows one correct item or a "not found" line
- hgTracks could corrupt memory when two bigRmsk tracks loaded at the same time with FreeType on; the FreeType width call used in the load threads is now locked
- A saved session with no db= in its contents crashed My Sessions, Backup Custom Tracks, and the Public Sessions gallery; all three now use one shared helper that handles a missing db and decodes the value
- Removed the svgBarChart hg.conf setting; SVG bar charts on the details page have been the default since v428
- Removed the useBlatBigPsl hg.conf setting; offering BLAT results as a bigPsl custom track has been the default since v349
- Removed the canSnake hg.conf setting; snake display for chain and alignment tracks has been the default since v468
- Removed the mergeRecommended hg.conf setting; merging a recommended track set into the current cart has been the default since v468
- Removed the canDupTracks hg.conf setting; duplicating a track has been the default since v444
- Removed the trackHubsCanAddGroups hg.conf setting; hub-defined track groups have been the default since v493
- hgLiftOver and hgConvert now offer liftOver to and from GenArk assemblies by default, without the genarkLiftOver hg.conf setting; a mirror with no genark table simply offers no GenArk assemblies
- BLAT results are now always saved as a custom track that can be reopened and shared, without the autoBlatBigPsl hg.conf setting
- Right-click "Zoom to this exon" (and enter codon/exon) in multi-region view gave an Error 500 or went to the wrong place; the menu now takes the chrom from the item's own link, and hgApi reports "Couldn't find item" instead of crashing
- hgApi exonToPos/codonToPos on a bigGenePred track labeled the answer with the requested chrom, so a multi-region caller got "multi:" with real coordinates; it now uses the chrom of the matching item
- For a bigGenePred name on two chroms (PAR copies, chrM/chrMT), hgApi exon zoom went to the wrong copy; it now prefers the match on the requested chrom
- A lifted RepeatMasker Viz. or bigRmsk item was dropped when none of its aligned blocks lifted, even when part of it lifted; it is now kept and drawn as a dashed unaligned extension, and its details page says that no aligned sequence maps
- The hgc details page of a quickLifted wig or bigWig now says when its values are in reverse order compared to the source assembly, and the message for a lifted wig with browser.quickLiftWig off uses the wording from QA
- Recommended track sets that connect a hub (ENIGMA, InSiGHT, and Exon Relevance) drew no hub tracks until the next page load; the hubs are now connected before the track list is built, so the tracks appear on the first load
- A lifted wig or bigWig with a logoMaf setting stopped hgTracks at base level with a database or maf error; lifted tracks now skip the source alignment and draw this assembly's base sized by the value
- A lifted rmsk or bigRmsk track left in a hub with browser.quickLiftRmsk off drew the source assembly's repeats at source coordinates; it now draws nothing, and with quickLiftMultiChain off an item in a segmental duplication is no longer dropped
- On hgc, a click on a bed 8, bed 9 without itemRgb, or bed 12 item lifted across species showed only the page title; the item is now lifted block by block as in hgTracks, and the page says so when no item matches
- Tidied the output of the RepeatMasker details pages
- The standard configuration page for composite tracks now lists a multiWig child of the composite, instead of the multiWig's own children, and links to the multiWig configuration page
- New trackDb setting heatmap.background sets the background color of heatmap displays; it should not be set to a color that could be confused with data values
- Fixed protein BLAT discarding alignments with overlapping query sequences
- A failing track inside a multiWig inside a composite now shows its error message instead of an empty yellow band
- A multiWig set to add or subtract no longer takes the page down when one of its children fails to load
- New track decorator setting decorator.default.maxDrawBases gives a window size in bases above which a decorator is not drawn, and warnings from tracks loaded in parallel, such as a decorator file that will not open, are now shown on the track instead of dropped
- Dot-bracket tracks no longer draw direction arrows in squish mode, where they read as structure
- The dotBracketColor setting now accepts colors written as #0000ff or blue, not only as 0,0,255, through a new colorSpec color-parsing library module
- New block of FreeType text rendering controls on the hgTracks configure page, for debugging font settings, behind the hg.conf setting freeTypeTuneUI
- Test fixes for barChartReorder, matrixNormalize, and mafToBigMafSummary, which left untracked files behind or failed under make -j
- gff3ToGenePred now includes pseudogenes in the resulting ncbiGene and ncbiRefSeq tracks
- Improved message packet handling between the parasol hub and node processes, which fixes long-running batches that made gigantic log files and stopped monitoring their long-running jobs
- New pushAccessions.sh script to push GenArk assemblies out to hgwbeta and the RR machines
- New pushContrib.sh script to push individual contrib tracks for a GenArk assembly
- New removal procedure for GenArk push maintenance to clean obsolete files from the /gbdb/genark/ hierarchy
- New compareLiftOverChains.py script to evaluate how well different alignment methods create liftOver files
- Reformatted the response email from the user liftOver request system
- Improved the automatic generation of common names for GenArk assemblies, to eliminate duplicated common names
- hgLogin no longer allows new usernames with leading or trailing spaces
- Fixed the chrom alias tooltip and the codon phase help icon in exon tooltips
- VCF REF allele strings are no longer copied onto the stack in hgvsGFromVariant() and vpGenomicToTranscript(), which long alleles could overflow
- A hub's directory row in Hub Space now leaves the db field blank and reads the genome from the hub's hub.txt file
- New Hub Space system measurement scripts, set up to run under the qateam account
